title: A scoping literature review of toxicological studies on per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,1527-1555
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00328H, Critical Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marianthi Papathanasiou, Haralampos Tzoupis, Konstantinos D. Papavasileiou, Francesco Dondero, Dario Greco, Iseult Lynch, Antreas Afantitis, Georgia Melagraki
A scoping review of 358 studies shows PFAS persist across humans and model systems, with immunotoxicity and hepatotoxicity as key effects and several alternatives showing toxicity profiles similar to legacy PFAS.
